item.title: Inside Tehran after strikes: Iranian woman describes fear, checkpoints and people used as ‘human shields’
item.summary: An anonymous Iranian woman detailed to The Australian the nightly explosions, celebrations and fear in Tehran as Trump's two-week ceasefire with Iran tentatively took hold.

item.title: Senate Dem accuses Trump of being 'unfit for office,' joins growing call to impeach, oust president
item.summary: Sen. Andy Kim, D-N.J., said President Donald Trump should be removed over the Iran war, citing the 25th Amendment and impeachment as Democrats escalate calls to oust the president.

item.title: MAN VS MACHINE: Philadelphians aren't taking kindly to sharing sidewalks with delivery robots
item.summary: Philadelphia residents are clashing with Uber Eats delivery robots, with incidents of kicking and sitting on the autonomous sidewalk couriers reported.

item.title: Melania Trump's forceful Epstein denial draws bipartisan support from lawmakers
item.summary: First lady Melania Trump denounced allegations tying her to Jeffrey Epstein, prompting bipartisan calls for congressional hearings and accountability.

item.title: Fever's Lexie Hull speaks out against attacks on players as team's popularity grows during Caitlin Clark era
item.summary: The Indiana Fever's Lexie Hull talks about increased social media scrutiny, louder arenas and life alongside Caitlin Clark ahead of the 2026 WNBA season.

item.title: Biden-appointed judge at center of repeated clashes with Trump administration issues new immigration block
item.summary: Biden-appointed Judge Brian Murphy blocked the deportation of thousands of Ethiopian migrants, finding DHS did not follow proper protocols to cancel their temporary protected status.

item.title: Child among 4 dead as accused arsonist allegedly drank beer during chaos
item.summary: Roman Amatitla was charged with murder and arson after allegedly setting a random Queens building fire that killed four, including a 3-year-old girl.

item.title: Neighbor fatally shoots alleged gunman after 2 women shot in domestic dispute
item.summary: A Washington state man allegedly shot two female relatives in a domestic dispute before a neighbor intervened and fatally shot him, police said.

item.title: Bruce Springsteen blasts rich men in America as critics call out his billions
item.summary: Bruce Springsteen sparked controversy with a fiery anti-Trump speech, but critics point out his reported $1.2 billion net worth undercuts his message.

item.title: California detective killed in ambush while serving eviction suspect barricaded in standoff
item.summary: A California detective was killed in a Porterville shooting while serving an eviction notice, with the suspect allegedly lying in wait, the sheriff says.
